comparison.objective: Place an already-unscrewed reagent cap inside-up without contaminating its interior; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate cap reorientation and forbidden-contact avoidance versus recessed tool insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Release cap on rest with no interior/rim contact versus two quantified acceptable stops and post-lock drift tolerance. Cap record omits pose/contact-clearance thresholds.
comparison.reason: Protected-surface handling is a different tested ability.
